messages:
sophie: Hey team — customer (AcmeRetail) reports duplicated tool executions and double billing when their app triggers a function call in short-window network flakiness. They see the tool run twice within ~200ms and two billable token events. Repro steps and logs below. Please advise.

sophie: Repro summary from customer: user clicks 'generate', backend calls Redwood chat endpoint with function_call, we return tool result and app observes two side effects (e.g., two orders created). They captured these fields: request_id=req_abc123, client_txn=txn_555, toolrun_ids=[toolrun_987, toolrun_988].

sophie: Customer curl (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -H "Idempotency-Key: client-txn-555" \ 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-rt-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"order 123"}],"functions":[{"name":"create_order","schema":{}}],"function_call":{"name":"create_order"}}'
```

sophie: From their trace: our runtime returned 200 then websocket ACK dropped; their client retried the HTTP call ~180ms later (same idempotency header). They got two successful tool invocations. Billing shows two billable tool-exec events.

raj: Thanks — past similar issues were idempotency propagation gaps and the runtime's tool-call retry path not deduping at the tool-run level. Can you paste the raw request/response headers and the internal run ids we emitted?

sophie: Pasted logs (redacted):
```
[1782001201] incoming req id=req_abc123 headers:{Idempotency-Key: client-txn-555, X-Forwarded-For: 52.14.1.2}
[1782001202] routed -> runtime-worker-7, assigned run_id=run_221
[1782001203] runtime -> tool-proxy create request tool_call_id=toolrun_987
[1782001203] runtime -> client 200 {status: exec_started, tool_call_id:toolrun_987}
[1782001203] socket ack lost (tcp retransmit)
[1782001383] client retried identical POST (same Idempotency-Key)
[1782001384] routed -> runtime-worker-2, assigned run_id=run_222
[1782001384] runtime -> tool-proxy create request tool_call_id=toolrun_988
[1782001385] runtime -> client 200 {status: exec_started, tool_call_id:toolrun_988}
[1782001400] tool-proxy completed toolrun_987 -> result: order created id=order_999
[1782001410] tool-proxy completed toolrun_988 -> result: order created id=order_1000
```

raj: Ok that matches hypothesis: two distinct runtime assignments (run_221 & run_222) each emitted a tool_call request. Looks like the Idempotency-Key from client didn't reach the tool-proxy or wasn't used to dedupe tool-run creation. Also runtime returned early status and the client retried — our early 200 + lost socket ACK produced a second independent run.

raj: Two action items: (1) immediate mitigation: treat function-call execution as "at-most-once" by propagating Idempotency-Key to tool-proxy and having tool-proxy check/return existing tool_run if the same key exists; (2) make runtime await tool-proxy ack before returning exec_started to caller (or return a 202 and require client to poll).

emma: From support side — customer wants credits for the duplicate orders and a short-term config change (disable automatic client retries or enable server-side dedupe) while you patch. Also they want a traced reproduction we can send to legal if needed.

ops-bot: Deployment logs: 1782001190 — rolling update to runtime-worker pool started. No known errors. Network flakiness reported on node us-west-2b at 1782001203 (packet drops ~120ms window).

billing-bot: Metering events show two billable tool_exec records for req_abc123 at 1782001400 and 1782001410, both charged to tenant AcmeRetail.

raj: Proposed short-term patch: when receiving a chat with function_call, runtime should attach X-Redwood-Idempotency: <Idempotency-Key|generated> to tool-proxy POST. Tool-proxy will upsert by that header. Also add a dedupe table with TTL 24h for tool runs keyed by (tenant, idempotency_key, function_name). Could we get a small hotfix for this week?

emma: Customer accepts that plan. They need a rollback-free hotfix and credits. Can we scope change to minimum: just idempotency propagate + tool-proxy upsert? Full wait-for-ACK behavior can be next sprint.

raj: Yes — I can push a minimal change to propagate header and do upsert on tool-proxy. I'll open PR and flag it for emergency review.

sophie: Repro steps for eng QA (customer-provided):
1) POST chat with function_call and Idempotency-Key header set to "client-txn-<random>"
2) drop ACK from server (simulate socket loss) right after receiving 200 (netem rule: drop response ACK)
3) client retries identical POST within 500ms
4) observe two toolrun ids unless dedupe enabled

sophie: Sample curl for QA (netem environment):
```bash
# set idempo header
curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat" \ 
  -H "Idempotency-Key: client-txn-555" \ 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-rt-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"create order"}],"functions":[{"name":"create_order"}],"function_call":{"name":"create_order"}}'
```

raj: I'll also add server-side test that simulates a lost ACK path and asserts tool-proxy upsert prevents double create. Will tag @eng-oncall for hotfix review.

emma: For billing: can we pre-authorize credit for the duplicate run while we fix? We need a request id and amount estimate.

billing-bot: Preliminary: duplicate tool runs incurred ~0.08 USD on tokens + per-tool-op fee 0.50 USD each -> estimate 1.08 USD extra. If multiple customers hit this we can batch credits. Please open a billing ticket with req_abc123 and tenant AcmeRetail.

sophie: Filed billing ticket SUP-4221 with log excerpts and tenant id. Customer will wait for hotfix. Thanks all. :pray:

raj: Starting work now — will post PR and link. If anyone sees more tenants with same signature, drop notes here.

sophie: Will monitor SUPPORT-4221 and update customer once PR merged.

emma: Marking this P1 internal. Thanks.
